login.codeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.codeHint: A recovery code can only be used once.

notice.reset: Your password was changed. Please sign in.
notice.invited: Your password is set. Please sign in.

errors.LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. The account is temporarily locked.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.EXPIRED: The sign-in expired. Please enter your password again.

forgot.sent: If the address belongs to an admin account, a reset link is on its way.

setPassword.inviteIntro: Choose a password to activate your Admin Portal account.
setPassword.resetIntro: Choose a new password. All your other sessions will be signed out.
setPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.

errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password must have at least {min} characters.
errors.TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for all admins.
errors.TWO_FACTOR_NO_SETUP: There is no pending setup. Start again.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. The account is temporarily locked.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: This e-mail address is already used.
errors.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: The last active super admin cannot be changed, deactivated or removed.

messages.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
messages.verificationSent: Confirmation link sent. Please check your inbox.
messages.alreadyVerified: Your e-mail address is already confirmed.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your profile, password and two-factor authentication.
account.setupRequired: Two-factor authentication is mandatory. Set it up with an authenticator app to continue.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Protect your sign-in with a code from an authenticator app.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The name shown in the Admin Portal.

password.title: Password
password.sessionsNote: Your other sessions are signed out when the password changes.

emailVerify.title: Confirm e-mail address
emailVerify.description: Confirming that this address belongs to you unlocks "My account" in the ticket shop: the next time you sign in there (or at the Admin Portal), you are also signed in as a customer with your own orders under this address. Without confirmation you still get the dashboard button in the shop, but "My account" is not linked – so nobody can reach someone else's orders just because an administrator was created with a mistyped or foreign address.
emailVerify.unverified: Your e-mail address ({email}) is not confirmed yet.

twoFactor.recoveryHint: Store these codes safely. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.codeHintAny: Authenticator code or a recovery code.
twoFactor.enabledNow: Two-factor authentication is on. Save your recovery codes now.
twoFactor.offIntro: Two-factor authentication is off. You can protect your account with an authenticator app (e.g. a TOTP app on your phone).
twoFactor.scanIntro: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.confirmHint: Turns on two-factor authentication once the code is correct.
twoFactor.onStatus: Two-factor authentication is on. Unused recovery codes: {count}.
twoFactor.requiredNote: It is mandatory for all admins and cannot be turned off.
twoFactor.regenerateHint: Creates 10 new codes; the old ones stop working.
twoFactor.disableHint: Needs your password and a current code.

users.title: Users
users.description: Admin Portal accounts, roles and invitations.

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.description: The user receives an e-mail with a one-time link to choose a password.

edit.title: Name and roles
edit.rolesNote: A role change signs the user out of all sessions.

operations.title: Account
operations.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate this user? All their sessions end.
operations.confirmResetTwoFactor: Reset two-factor authentication of this user? They are signed out and must set it up again.

security.title: Security
security.description: Sessions, lockout, passwords and two-factor authentication of admin users.
security.requireTwoFactorHint: Every admin must use an authenticator app. Users without one are taken to the setup right after signing in.

scanner.title: Check-in scanner
scanner.description: Behaviour of the Android check-in app.
scanner.phaseNote: Devices are paired and managed under “Check-in devices”. These values apply to all devices.
scanner.allowCheckOutHint: Door staff can check a guest out again (pass-out / re-entry).
scanner.offlineModeAllowedHint: Devices may download all tickets and scan without a connection.
scanner.lanSyncEnabled: Sync between devices on the local network
scanner.lanSyncEnabledHint: Scanners on the same WiFi exchange scans so no ticket enters twice.
scanner.syncIntervalSecondsHint: How often online devices fetch changes.
scanner.pairingCodeTtlMinutesHint: Lifetime of the QR code used to pair a device.
scanner.serverUrlHint: Address a phone can reach this server at, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8080 on the venue network. Used in the pairing QR code and download links. Empty = public shop address (localhost does not work on phones).

resultColors.title: Result colours
resultColors.hint: Screen colour of the scan result. Reduced tariffs show the yellow; rarer hints have their own colour. If a ticket has several hints, the most important one decides the screen colour (reduction, wrong entrance, additional payment, wheelchair / companion); the others appear as chips.

appUpdates.title: App updates
appUpdates.hint: Where paired scanner apps look for a newer version. Updates are always checked against a SHA-256 checksum and the app signature before installing.

sources.GITHUBHint: The app fetches the release list from GitHub and downloads the APK from there.
sources.SERVERHint: The app downloads the APK that was uploaded under “Check-in devices”.

appUpdates.githubRepositoryHint: owner/repo of the releases, e.g. a fork of the project. Empty = the repository built into the app.
appUpdates.defaultUpdateChannelHint: Stable = final releases only. Next = also pre-releases (alpha, beta, rc).
appUpdates.allowChannelOverride: Allow changing the channel in the app
appUpdates.allowChannelOverrideHint: Operators may pick another channel in the app settings.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm e-mail address
verifyEmail.intro: Press the button to confirm that this e-mail address belongs to you.
verifyEmail.done: Your e-mail address is confirmed. At your next sign-in in the shop, "My account" is linked.
verifyEmail.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. You can request a new one in your account settings.
